can be changed by giving a different distance unit. For example,

Output Format 
Printout format only affects output files, but it affects all output files including plot 
frles and EGS database files. It is given by the letter e or& followed by a period, fol- 
lowed by a number. The letter tells whether the variable is printed in e-format or f- 
format. E-format is commonly used in computers for scientific notation; for exam- 
ple, the number 250 is printed as 2.50e02 where e02 means x102. F-format prints 
numbers the standard way, that is, 250 is printed as 250. The number following the 
period tells how many digits are printed following the decimal point.
